svg.aria-label: self-healing-infra: an EC2 web server that repairs itself. A health metric is reported every minute; when nginx stops, a CloudWatch alarm invokes Lambda, which restarts nginx through Systems Manager. The drawing shows the metric dropping from 1 to 0, the alarm, the restart and the return to OK.
